task.title: Apple Watch Workout app architecture/product audit and implementation plan

authority.build80_training_delta: none; Build 80 is Home widget formatting plus build metadata

result.summary: Comprehensive non-shipping audit recommends phone-authoritative structured Logger plus Watch-authoritative HealthKit workout, revisioned/idempotent WatchConnectivity commands, mirrored-session Live Activity adoption, deterministic External UUID reconciliation, explicit pause/rest clocks, and a phone-reachable V1 start from a prepared workout. Early-finish proof confirms unfinished planned sets do not become evidence, but finds a release-blocking partial-superset edge: when one member has zero completed sets, Native sends a dangling relationship and Server rejects the entire finish atomically.

native_payload_proof.summary: Focused Build 79 simulator test with audit-only assertions proved the commit payload contained the completed set and excluded the unfinished planned set; temporary assertions were removed.

server_partial_superset_proof.summary: Audit-only Vitest cases passed within a 55/55 file run: both partially performed members commit correctly; one wholly unperformed member causes atomic TRAINING_SUPERSET_INVALID with no evidence mutation. Temporary tests were removed.

source_cleanliness.summary: Build 79 audit source was clean after instrumentation removal; no product code changed.

decisions_required: Approve phone-reachable structured start for V1 while removing any dependency on HealthKit synchronization.
Approve phone-prepared Ready for Watch workouts as the V1 start source.
Approve confirmation for every Finish action, including after the final planned set.
Approve Total Calories as unavailable when basal energy cannot be established.
Approve traditional indoor strength training and watchOS 11+ for V1.
blockers: Fix performed-session relationship projection before Watch shipping: filter each relationship to performed occurrence ids and drop groups with fewer than two performed members, then add evidence-level partial-superset tests.
recommended_next_step: Execute Phase 0 only: repair and prove early-finish relationship projection, introduce prepared/active/paused/finishing lifecycle and pure shared protocol/clock contracts, then run a disposable Watch target/signing spike before building UI.
